EC1: Fasting plasma glucose [OR] > 7,0 mM, HbA1c > 48 mmol/mol 3 months after RYGB.
EC2: Dysregulated thyroid diseases [OR], use of antithyroid treatment.
EC3: Late diabetic complications [OR] as retinopathy [OR], renal insufficiency [OR], neuropathy or previous pancreatitis.
EC4: Complications [AND] to RYGB. Documented reactive hypoglycaemia, severe dumping (vomiting [OR], diarrhea [OR], severe abdominal pain after food intake).
